en.text: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 人为妇人所生， 日子短少，多有患难；

zhTraditional.text: 人為婦人所生， 日子短少，多有患難；

en.text: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

zhSimplified.text: 出来如花，又被割下， 飞去如影，不能存留。

zhTraditional.text: 出來如花，又被割下， 飛去如影，不能存留。

en.text: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

zhSimplified.text: 这样的人你岂睁眼看他吗？ 又叫我来受审吗？

zhTraditional.text: 這樣的人你豈睜眼看他嗎？ 又叫我來受審嗎？

en.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

zhSimplified.text: 谁能使洁净之物出于污秽之中呢？ 无论谁也不能！

zhTraditional.text: 誰能使潔淨之物出於污穢之中呢？ 無論誰也不能！

en.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

zhSimplified.text: 人的日子既然限定， 他的月数在你那里， 你也派定他的界限，使他不能越过，

zhTraditional.text: 人的日子既然限定， 他的月數在你那裏， 你也派定他的界限，使他不能越過，

en.text: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

zhSimplified.text: 便求你转眼不看他，使他得歇息， 直等他像雇工人完毕他的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 便求你轉眼不看他，使他得歇息， 直等他像雇工人完畢他的日子。

en.text: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

zhSimplified.text: 树若被砍下， 还可指望发芽， 嫩枝生长不息；

zhTraditional.text: 樹若被砍下， 還可指望發芽， 嫩枝生長不息；

en.text: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

zhSimplified.text: 其根虽然衰老在地里， 干也死在土中，

zhTraditional.text: 其根雖然衰老在地裏， 幹也死在土中，

en.text: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

zhSimplified.text: 及至得了水气，还要发芽， 又长枝条，像新栽的树一样。

zhTraditional.text: 及至得了水氣，還要發芽， 又長枝條，像新栽的樹一樣。

en.text: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

zhSimplified.text: 但人死亡而消灭； 他气绝，竟在何处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 但人死亡而消滅； 他氣絕，竟在何處呢？

en.text: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

zhSimplified.text: 海中的水绝尽， 江河消散干涸。

zhTraditional.text: 海中的水絕盡， 江河消散乾涸。

en.text: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

zhSimplified.text: 人也是如此，躺下不再起来， 等到天没有了，仍不得复醒， 也不得从睡中唤醒。

zhTraditional.text: 人也是如此，躺下不再起來， 等到天沒有了，仍不得復醒， 也不得從睡中喚醒。

en.text: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

footnotes.text: 14:13 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 惟愿你把我藏在阴间， 存于隐密处，等你的忿怒过去； 愿你为我定了日期，记念我。

zhTraditional.text: 惟願你把我藏在陰間， 存於隱密處，等你的忿怒過去； 願你為我定了日期，記念我。

en.text: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

zhSimplified.text: 人若死了岂能再活呢？ 我只要在我一切争战的日子， 等我被释放的时候来到。

zhTraditional.text: 人若死了豈能再活呢？ 我只要在我一切爭戰的日子， 等我被釋放的時候來到。

en.text: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

zhSimplified.text: 你呼叫，我便回答； 你手所做的，你必羡慕。

zhTraditional.text: 你呼叫，我便回答； 你手所做的，你必羨慕。

en.text: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

zhSimplified.text: 但如今你数点我的脚步， 岂不窥察我的罪过吗？

zhTraditional.text: 但如今你數點我的腳步， 豈不窺察我的罪過嗎？

en.text: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 我的过犯被你封在囊中， 也缝严了我的罪孽。

zhTraditional.text: 我的過犯被你封在囊中， 也縫嚴了我的罪孽。

en.text: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

zhSimplified.text: 山崩变为无有； 磐石挪开原处。

zhTraditional.text: 山崩變為無有； 磐石挪開原處。

en.text: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

zhSimplified.text: 水流消磨石头， 所流溢的洗去地上的尘土； 你也照样灭绝人的指望。

zhTraditional.text: 水流消磨石頭， 所流溢的洗去地上的塵土； 你也照樣滅絕人的指望。

en.text: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

zhSimplified.text: 你攻击人常常得胜，使他去世； 你改变他的容貌，叫他往而不回。

zhTraditional.text: 你攻擊人常常得勝，使他去世； 你改變他的容貌，叫他往而不回。

en.text: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

zhSimplified.text: 他儿子得尊荣，他也不知道， 降为卑，他也不觉得。

zhTraditional.text: 他兒子得尊榮，他也不知道， 降為卑，他也不覺得。

en.text: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

zhSimplified.text: 但知身上疼痛， 心中悲哀。

zhTraditional.text: 但知身上疼痛， 心中悲哀。
